cmd.description: Owner only: member and server-structure backups for recovering from a lost server
cmd.status: How many members can be restored
cmd.restore: Add every restorable member to a server the bot is in
cmd.restoreServer: ID of the server to add them to
cmd.snapshot: Save the main server's roles and channels now (also done daily)
cmd.snapshots: List saved snapshots of the main server
cmd.changes: What changed in the main server since a snapshot (deleted roles/channels, permissions)
cmd.revert: Undo a nuke: restore deleted roles/channels and permissions from a snapshot
cmd.rebuild: Recreate the main server's roles and channels in another server

backup.ownerOnly: Only the server owner can use /backup.
backup.noMain: I cannot reach the main server.
backup.revertConfirm: **Revert the main server to this snapshot?** Deleted roles and channels are recreated with their permissions, and changed permissions are put back. Nothing created since is deleted.
backup.snapshotsHelp: Compare with the server now: `/backup changes snapshot:<number>` · undo a nuke: `/backup revert` · rebuild elsewhere: `/backup rebuild server_id:<id> snapshot:<number>`.
backup.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. One is taken every day, or now with `/backup snapshot`.
backup.notInServerAdmin: I am not in that server. Invite the bot there first, with Administrator.
backup.rebuildDifferent: Rebuild creates the main server's structure in a *different* server.
backup.needAdmin: Give me **Administrator** in {server} first, so I can create roles and channels with their permissions.
backup.rebuildStarted: Creating {summary} from snapshot #{id} in **{server}**. Existing roles and channels there are left alone.
backup.rebuildFinished: **Rebuild of {server} finished:** {roles} roles and {channels} channels created, {failed} failed. Next: `/backup restore server_id:{serverId}` to bring the members.
backup.statusStored: **Restorable into Mewvo's own servers:** {stored} (verified there with "Verify with Discord")
backup.statusInMain: **Of them in the main server now:** {inGuild}
backup.statusHelp: Restore with `/backup restore server_id:<id>`. Only the main server, the support server or one in MEMBER_RESTORE_GUILD_IDS, and only members who verified in Mewvo's own servers (a verification in another server never counts). The bot must be in that server with **Create Invite**. Members with an active ban are skipped.
backup.notInServer: I am not in that server. Invite the bot there first.
backup.needInvite: I need the **Create Invite** permission in {server} to add members.
backup.restoreRunning: A restore is already running. Check `/backup status`.
backup.restoreStarted: Adding up to **{stored}** members who verified for **{server}**. This message updates as it goes, and you get a DM when it is done.

cmd.description: Owner only: read-only lookups across the whole database
cmd.user: Everything stored about one user, in every server
cmd.server: Settings, module states, row counts and open appeals of one server
cmd.case: One case with its edits, evidence, notes and appeals
cmd.stats: Row counts per table, schema version, size, oldest and newest rows
cmd.search: Search case codes, reasons and stored usernames

database.dbError: The database is not responding right now, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
database.footer: Page {page} of {total} · read-only · secrets are hidden
database.morePages: _…more pages left out; narrow the lookup._

input.notUser: That is not a user ID or @mention.
input.notServer: That is not a server ID.
input.notCase: That is not a case code (5 to 7 letters and digits).

section.searchCases: Cases (code, reason, member or moderator name)

cmd.description: Send yourself the DM an action would send and save a test case. Nothing is executed
cmd.user: Who the DM would be for (they receive nothing)
cmd.noAppeal: Ban only: preview a ban they cannot appeal

test.serverOnly: This command only works in a server.
test.noAdmin: You need the Administrator permission to use /test.
test.badDuration: That duration is not valid. Use e.g. `30m`, `12h`, `7d`, `2w` or `1mo` (at least 1 minute).
test.noDatabase: The database is unavailable, so no test case can be saved. Try again later.
test.muteNeedsDuration: A mute needs a duration, e.g. `duration:1h`.
test.noteLadder: this warn reaches the limit, so they'd get the automatic ladder-level-{level} ban DM instead (warn `{code}` was saved too)
test.dmFailed: I could not DM you. Allow direct messages from server members in this server and try again.
test.caseSaved: Test case `{code}` was saved, so it can be appealed and decided with /appeals like a real one.
test.appealSupport: Appeal it from the support server with that code.
test.appealWithCode: Appeal it with that code (the DM says where).
test.onlyTarget: Only {name} can appeal it; run /test on yourself to try the appeal flow.
test.realInvite: The invite in it is a real one-time invite to this server.
